newsitem.title: KUWAIT: BP says ties with Saudi Arabia very important.
newsitem.headline: BP says ties with Saudi Arabia very important.

text.p: British Petroleum Plc said on Saturday the loss of marketing some Saudi Arabian crude under an oil-for-arms deal with London was not a material issue but that it was important to maintain ties with the Saudi kingdom.
BP chief executive John Browne told Reuters the decade-old arrangement which was terminated in 1997 "is very nice to have".
"But the decision is made and we have to carry on," he added, without disclosing the loss of revenue.
Royal Dutch/Shell Group and BP marketed some 400,000 barrels per day of Saudi crude, passing the proceeds to British Aerospace Plc to pay for the arms.
"It is not a material thing for BP. It is very important to have links with large producers," Browne said of the world's largest oil producer and exporter.
